english.title: Owner of motor vehicle failing to give information as to insurance to police - RTA 1988
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the owner of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), failed to give such information as was required, by or on behalf of the chief officer of police, for the purpose of determining whether that motor vehicle was or was not being driven in contravention of section 143 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 on an occasion when the driver, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DRIVER..), was required under

(A)_[section 165(1)]_
(B)_[section 170]_

of the Road Traffic Act 1988 to produce a certificate of insurance, or other evidence, as is mentioned in section 165(2)(a) of the Act
english.legislation: Contrary to section 171 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and schedule 2 of the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) The offence only applies to the OWNER of the vehicle. For the registered keeper offence see section 172 of the Road Traffic Act 1988.
(ii) Until 1st November 2021, securities or deposits could be used as an alternative to conventional motor insurance. For offences before that date see H8500.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, being the owner of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), failed to give such information as was required, by or on behalf of the chief officer of police, for the purpose of determining whether that motor vehicle was or was not being driven with the necessary third party insurance on an occasion when the driver, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DRIVER..), was required under to produce a certificate of insurance, or other evidence.
